question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

Kids who weren't restrained at all definitly suffered the consequences.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect spelling of the word "**definitly**."
 
• The correct spelling should be "**definitely**."
 
• Ensuring correct spelling is crucial for clarity and professionalism in writing.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Kids who weren't restrained at all **definitely** suffered the consequences."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "restrained"** – This word is correctly spelt and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "suffered"** – This word is correctly spelt and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "consequences"** – This word is correctly spelt and does not require any changes.
